replies.body: Fixed in provider v4.3.9, which is now synced into this PR. A missing `repeat_mode` now defaults to `NONE` before mapping, so it is mirrored as `RepeatMode.OFF`, matching queue navigation. A peer that clears repeat by omitting the option resets the AudioSource session instead of leaving repeat-one/all visible. A regression test covers a session that previously showed repeat-one.
